Name: Fence Decorations
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

This mod disables the torch-only restriction when placing things on fences. It also adds some logic to allow furniture placed on fences (e.g. Decorative Lanterns) to emit their light.

Note that many things are not meant to be put on fences (e.g. couches, fireplaces, etc.) and will just look odd. Also, putting certain private belongings of others on fences is just plain rude.

Tools and other non-objects cannot be placed on fences.

The mod causes decorations (including torches) to be dropped when a fence is destroyed, as opposed to just causing the objects to disappear. You can revert this in the config if you enjoy pondering existential questions like where all the missing socks go.

The mod also removes held object offsets from fence data, so objects on end posts will be in the same exact spot on the fence as others. You can revert this in the config if you prefer being off center.


[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
